narrative_vs_numbers.point: PAT fell 15.7% YoY in Sep 2026 despite revenue growing 20.3% to ₹2,569 crore.
Free cash flow plunged from ₹500 crore in FY25 to ₹165 crore in FY26 under heavy capex.
Borrowings grew nearly 3x from ₹1,299 crore in FY24 to ₹3,795 crore in Sep 2026.

bull: Revenue YoY growth accelerated to 20.3% in Sep 2026, reaching ₹2,569 crore.
Operating cash flow expanded to ₹1,633 crore in FY26 with strong 5-year cash conversion of 1.16x.
FY26 EBITDA grew to ₹2,243 crore maintaining a healthy 27.0% margin.
bear: PAT contracted by 15.7% YoY in Sep 2026 to ₹414 crore due to cost pressure.
Total debt expanded significantly to ₹3,795 crore by Sep 2026, driving D/E to 0.33.
FCF dropped to ₹165 crore in FY26 despite operating cash flow of ₹1,633 crore.
